items.title: John Casimir Interview, 1959-01-17
items.q: Who else did you see in the street? ... Joe Watson played the class. ... So I could follow him sometime.

ctx.x: Johnny Dobson, B flat. We never had no E flat. Who else did you see in the street?
What other? I wanted a band. Joe Watson played the class. The old tuxedo band.

He had E flat with a tuxedo band and a B flat in the orchestra. So I could follow him sometime. None of them don't apply like Johnny Dobson. That tonation was there. Yeah.
